responsibility: Provides the AVX10.2 saturated-conversion intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit vectors plus scalar truncating conversions. It defines narrow-width conversions from BF16, FP16, FP32, and FP64 to signed or unsigned integer element types, including saturating and truncating variants with optional rounding controls, and also exposes scalar `_mm_cvtts_round*` helpers for rounded FP-to-int extraction.
